title: A Stronger Teacher Within: Strengthening MoE Models via On-Policy Bidirectional Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, but its outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision. On-Policy Distillation offers dense token-level feedback, yet requires a stronger compatible teacher, while on-policy self-distillation relies on hand-designed privileged information. We observe that the MoE architecture itself offers a way to resolve this dilemma, as increasing the activation budget per token exposes latent expert capacity and yields a potentially stronger teacher within the model. However, naive expansion degrades performance because newly co-activated experts are not optimized to work together. translated_title: 内在的更强教师：通过策略内双向蒸馏增强MoE模型
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升了混合专家（MoE）大语言模型，但其结果层面的奖励只能提供稀疏的监督信号。策略内蒸馏提供了密集的token级反馈，然而需要一个更强的兼容教师模型，而策略内自蒸馏则依赖于手工设计的特权信息。我们观察到，MoE架构本身提供了一种解决这一困境的方法：增加每个token的激活预算可以释放潜在的专家容量，从而在模型内部产生一个潜在更强的教师。然而，简单的扩展会降低性能，因为新共同激活的专家并未经过协同工作的优化。因此，我们提出了MoEvolve，一个遵循“先恢复后提升”策略的双向蒸馏框架：我们首先恢复激活扩展后的高k模型，并通过利用其额外的激活容量进一步强化它，然后将（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MoEvolve框架，通过增加MoE模型每token激活预算来挖掘模型内部潜在更强教师，并采用“先恢复后提升”的策略内双向蒸馏策略强化MoE大语言模型。
en_tdlr: MoEvolve is a bidirectional distillation framework that exposes a stronger teacher within MoE models by increasing the per-token activation budget, and strengthens MoE LLMs through a recovery-then-improvement on-policy distillation strategy.
